about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: About Me
about.description:
When facing problems, I compare multiple solutions and clearly document the reasoning behind my choices. 
I don't leave ambiguous requirements as they are—I discuss with planners and designers first to clarify requirements before starting development. 
I go beyond just implementing features, considering performance optimization and user experience, while actively applying patterns like Type Guard and Query Key Factory to enhance runtime stability and maintainability.
